probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder __that is not a glue__; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface.

Claim 3 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.

Claim 9 (Previously presented): A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

Claim 10 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

Claim 11 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is premixed solder paste.

Claim 12 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

Claim 13 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

Claim 14 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 pm in size.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are __greater than 50 micrometers and__ 100-200 p m in size.

Claim 16 (Previously presented): A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles.

Claim 17 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 16, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

Claim 18 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 16, wherein the binder is premixed solder paste.

Claim 19 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

Claim 20 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

Claim 21 (Previously presented): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 p m in size.

Claim 22 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are __greater than 50 micrometers and__ 100-200 m in size.
